vertical-asymptote.def: A vertical line $x = a$ near which a function's outputs increase or decrease without bound. A rational function has one where $(x - a)$ divides the denominator more times than the numerator.

one-sided-limit.def: The behavior of $f(x)$ as $x$ approaches $a$ from one side: $\lim_{x \to a^-} f(x)$ from the left, $\lim_{x \to a^+} f(x)$ from the right. At a vertical asymptote each is $\infty$ or $-\infty$.
